name: agenda
description: Pane of open questions, items Claude left undone, and a cross-session scratch pad; answer, dismiss or fire off each one.

extractorModel.title: Summary model (which Claude writes the pane's one-liners)
extractorModel.description: The Agenda pane runs a small background Claude call after each reply to pull out open questions and unfinished work, and to write one-line summaries of what each subagent is doing. This picks which Claude does that. "haiku" is the cheapest and fast, and is all this job needs; it never changes which model answers you in the main chat. Leave it at haiku unless the one-liners read badly.
